program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((zero-objs (objects (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
                            (lambda (r c) (if (= (at g r c) 0) 1 0)))
                           0)))
    (define (neighbor-colors obj)
      (remove-duplicates
        (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 8))))
          (for*/list ([p (in-list (obj-cells obj))]
                      [d (in-list cardinal-deltas)]
                      #:when (in-bounds? (+ (first p) (first d))
                                         (+ (second p) (second d))
                                         (rows g) (cols g)))
            (at g (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (in-list zero-objs)])
      (let ((colors (neighbor-colors obj)))
        (if (= (length colors) 1)
            (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) (first colors))
            out)))))
